start_rule: T0 = first future actually persisted current-mode forecast after protocol freeze and M4.2 data-rights/provenance acceptance; never a historical/replayed/backfilled timestamp

decision_rule.earliest: exchange calendar session close + max(900 seconds, documented provider delay), and actual validated observation/persistence completed

data_rules: UTC actual request-start, response-received, first-observed and stored-at; published-at optional and distinct
No input observed after decision; no current forecast from historical snapshot
Existing six features only, same units/adjustment semantics/code; frozen as-of prefix + data hashes
No mutable historical overwrite; append source revisions; log missing/failed forecasts
Corporate-action/adjustment-basis conflicts block outcome until protocol-compliant evidence; never create a direction across incompatible price bases

baselines.training_prevalence: frozen per-model training_positive_rate; no updating from prospective observations

primary_metric: brier_score and paired difference against training_prevalence

uncertainty.cluster: all tickers from same date resampled together
uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive uncertainty; no automatic production superiority claim

analysis_rule: one prespecified primary analysis after all minima and outcomes matured; earlier summaries descriptive only; fixed-universe and per-ticker reports; no optional stopping/model selection
immutability: Persist request, features, source/version hashes, probability and generated_at before target session
Outcomes stored separately after target close + delay and actual observation; preserve first accepted label and later revisions
No historical replay admitted into prospective cohort; no filling missed predictions after their targets
Protocol, models, thresholds and features may not be optimized from retrospective scores; any future change requires protocol v2 and separate cohort
